messages:
lee: Noticing a spike in SAST findings on staging after the roleflip this morning. Lots of exec/path and temp-file warnings in infra/ and tools/. Anyone touching RBAC recently? :confused:
devops-bot: Alert: SAST scan kestrel-stg-2026-03-21 reported 62 findings (top rule: exec-path-injection).
nana: I rotated a few role bindings around 09:55 UTC to move service accounts to the new infra-team group. Which SA is failing?
lee: The failures correlate with staging-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com losing access to the KMS key used for build secrets. We see fallback paths that write /tmp/build_secret which triggers the SAST rule.
oliver: Confirming from logs: cloudkms access denied at 09:56:12 UTC for staging-runner. Excerpt: protoPayload.methodName="cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.access", status.code=7, principalEmail="staging-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com".
nana: Oops, my PR modified the group binding and I accidentally removed the key-decrypt role for the runner. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1198 — I can revert or rebind now.
lee: Let's rebind rather than revert the whole PR. We need a short suppression to avoid noisy alerts while we fix and collect evidence. Policy requires: attach KMS audit logs, role-binding diff, and list of affected commits. Can someone approve a timeboxed suppression?
oliver: I can approve a 2-hour suppression for staging paths under infra/* if we attach logs to the ticket. I'll also request the audit export for the deny window.
nana: Rebinding command ready: gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/build/cryptoKeys/builder-key --member=serviceAccount:staging-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter. Will apply immediately after approval.
qa-bot: Note: DAST nightly also failed for a quick smoke this morning but likely unrelated. Posting job ids: dast-smoke-421 and sast-nightly-88.
lee: Okay go ahead with the rebind, please paste the exact command output and gcloud logging read snippet you used to capture the denies. We'll need those for SEC ticket evidence.
nana: Applied rebind at 10:03:30 UTC. gcloud output: "Updated IAM policy for key builder-key". Running log extract: gcloud logging read "protoPayload.resourceName:\"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/build/cryptoKeys/builder-key\" AND protoPayload.status.code=7" --limit=50 --format=json > sec-5210008888-kms-deny.json
lee: Great. I opened SEC-2401 and attached initial artifacts (PR link, rebind command, log extract, and scan ids). I also created a suppression: pattern=infra/*, env=staging, duration=2h, reason="temporary suppression while KMS decrypt restored".
devops-bot: Suppression infra/* @staging created by lee  expires in 2h.
oliver: Re-run the SAST job manually: triggering sast-manual-run-521 now. I'll watch for new exec-path-injection hits.
qa-bot: sast-manual-run-521 completed: findings dropped from 62 -> 5 (all legacy scripts), none referencing dynamic tmp files. The major noise cleared.
lee: Thanks. Next steps: 1) remove suppression once all scans stable 2) update RBAC PR to ensure future roleflip check includes KMS permissions 3) add a premerge check that simulates KMS deny to detect fallback paths. Adding action items to SEC-2401.
nana: Sorry for the churn, will add a checklist entry to infra PR template.
lee: No worries — good catch. Closing the loop when suppression is removed and final scan artifacts uploaded.
qa-bot: Reminder: add a note to the postmortem about how DAST smoke failed earlier; include whether it was coincidental.
